name: Skinwalkers
desc:
🚂 The cure you brought to Mexico using a train spilled, mutating bacteria into shapeshifting monsters called Skinwalkers. 

🥸 These monsters are able to disguise themselves as humans but it's not perfect.

🔭 The president ordered a human-only border, protect humans by only allowing civilian evacuees and sniping the monsters down

P.S. This is a shooter and skill based game in the morning, at night it's a scary horror game 😉
